title: Trump Threatens 100% Tariffs on Chinese Goods
summary: The president made the threat after Beijing imposed new global restrictions on the use of rare earth minerals, which are vital supplies for U.S. makers of chips and batteries.

title: Inflation Report Will Be Released Despite Shutdown
summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics is calling back some employees to produce the Consumer Price Index for September. That data is needed to calculate the annual cost-of-living adjustment for Social Security beneficiaries.

title: UK’s £120 Billion Investment Not Yet Coming to Starmer’s Rescue
summary: Keir Starmer’s “defining mission” of spurring stronger growth in the UK economy relies on investment that so far is barely showing up.
